title_en: At the Aviation Field, Super Apartment 1+1 for sale, together with a parking post included in the price!!
description_en: At the Former Aviation Field, Super Apartment 1+1 for Sale with Perfect Layout and Location!!! The apartment is located on the 5th floor of an 8-story building with an elevator. The property has a gross area of ​​65 m2 and a net area of ​​56.34 m2. The apartment is organized in a living room together with a kitchen corner, a matrimonial room, and a day toilet. The orientation of the apartment is West, allowing light and view. The property also has a parking post included in the price. Currently, the construction is in the carbine phase on the 5th floor and is expected to be completed within a period of 1.5-2 years.
